# omnigate

Migrate to Omarchy, natively. Moves a full OS setup (apps, configs, user
data, game libraries) from Linux/macOS/Windows to Omarchy without treating
migration as a file copy. Union-mount (zero-copy), differential sync,
declarative manifest, two-sided export/import.

- Repo: https://github.com/reverb256/omnigate
- Docs: https://github.com/reverb256/omnigate/tree/main/docs
- License: MIT
- Language: Python (stdlib)
- Architecture: scanner → mapper (defer rule) → generator; mount.py
  (overlayfs/Ghost Drive); sync.py (reflink differential)
